config.selection: bull puts only; prior-close SPY>100d SMA; parity percentile > 12%; top-10/day; k=4, GROUND ≥ 0.005 — configuration selected with 2026 in view: NOT a clean holdout
config.scoring: G = Kelly log-growth on P_real at the smile-fit model credit; GROUND = (e^G−1)·e^(−k·D_ent)
config.fill_basis: 1.08× smile-fit model credit (19 real fills), $1.30 commission/spread; partial-WIN at 50% intrinsic
config.regime: bull puts only when prior-session SPY close > 100d SMA; cash otherwise
config.dkl: D_ent = D(Q_bs‖U₃) = ln3 − H(Q_bs), Q_bs = N(d2) at the smile-fit IVs (Mercurio–Wu–Xie 2020 eq. 19)
config.window: 252 full sessions of realized DTE-matched moves vs the exact strikes (P_real, every trading day)
config.gap_drift: P_real drift = 1 × β_year σ × z(the stock's OWN opening gap, ATR units) × √DTE; no market average; β walk-forward, fitted on years before entry (§0.45)
config.parity: same-strike call-IV minus put-IV daily percentile > 12%
config.credit_basis: smile-fit model credit (no vendor quote at the strike is used)
